title: Implement reference soft demapper
description:
Add the generic reference soft-decision demapper for arbitrary constellations and arbitrary bit partitions.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] The generic demapper computes per-bit soft information for arbitrary valid constellations.
- [ ] The implementation is correct for non-Gray and non-square mappings, not only standard QAM.
- [ ] The output format matches the shared batch demapper contract.

## Notes

This task provides the correctness baseline that optimized demappers must match.
